reason: The prior one-search budget was an over-restriction caused by a poor search method. Research OS forbids unbounded archaeology, not a fixed number of narrow searches.

each_search_requires: a concrete load-bearing question tied to the active missing object
a narrow named scope: canonical handoff, implicated path/directory, exact object terms, or a concrete source path discovered by a prior hit
a stated reason why the next query can add materially new evidence rather than merely reformulate a miss
allowed_refinement: follow an exact source/certificate/provenance path exposed by a prior bounded hit
change query terms when the change corresponds to a newly identified mathematical alias, basis name, map name, producer, or artifact family
inspect multiple bounded candidate families when each is independently implicated by the active leaf
stop_conditions: the immediate bounded question is answered
the concretely identified candidate family is exhausted
the desired reusable asset is found and source-locked
the next search would require repository-wide enumeration, branch-history archaeology, or unconstrained keyword expansion
further query reformulation has no new mathematical signal or newly identified source path
forbidden: recursive repository-wide enumeration as ordinary discovery
automatic branch-history/origin archaeology after a miss
repeating near-equivalent searches solely to chase a negative result
